result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a continuous sidewalk on one side of the street, but it is interrupted by a very wide driveway serving a postal facility. The lack of a buffer between the walkway and the roadway, combined with the large vehicle conflict zone at the driveway, reduces overall pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Wide Driveway Conflict Zone
hazards.description: A very wide curb cut for the postal facility creates a large area where pedestrians must cross vehicle paths without protection or clear priority.
hazards.location_in_image: Left-center foreground where the sidewalk meets the large concrete apron

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and the building edge may block sight lines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers exiting the postal lot.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image near the parked red and white vehicles

interventions.title: Driveway Narrowing
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the driveway entrance using curb extensions to slow turning vehicles and shorten the pedestrian exposure distance.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and elevation across the driveway to clearly signal pedestrian priority to drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Ensure no vehicles are parked close to the driveway exit to maintain clear sight lines for both drivers and pedestrians.
